event.name: July 2025 Central Texas Hill Country flood

aoi.description: Working search AOI: Kerr County (GEOID 48265) buffered 10 km. Replace with a hydrologic (HUC) boundary after Phase 1 coverage review.

ro107.rationale: Ascending RO107. Post 2025-07-10 19:35 CDT falls in the low-flow gap between the 4 July flood and the 13-15 July second pulse (USGS: Hunt 194 cfs, Kerrville 209 cfs), so it is the cleaner view of 4 July persistent change. Covers 61% of the buffered AOI, including the whole Hunt-Comfort corridor. Pre 2025-06-28 and control 2025-06-16 at baseflow. See docs/acquisition/sentinel1_selection.md.

ro005.rationale: Ascending RO005, full AOI coverage. The granule dated 2025-07-04 was sensed 2025-07-03 19:43 CDT, before flood onset, so it is the pre scene. Post 2025-07-15 19:43 CDT is ~1 day after the 13-15 July second pulse peak (Kerrville 1,990 cfs at sensing), so change mixes 4 July after-effects with second-event water and soil wetting. Control 2025-06-21. Processed in tx_trial_01.
